name: 48324 · W Bloomfield, MI
findings: ZIP 48324 (W Bloomfield) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48324 (W Bloomfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
